messages:
noah: mid-standup chaos: my ISP did maintenance and now my 5GHz SSID vanished. switched to 2.4GHz and my video looks like a flipbook. also my cat knocked over the succulent and now my desk looks like cable modern art. pic: https://files.redwood.com/noah/desk_disaster.jpg
tanya: ugh been there. quick checks: did the router reboot? try power cycle first. also 5GHz sometimes disappears if the radio crashes
noah: did a reboot already, LED went amber for a bit then came back. still no 5G. the router ui shows both radios enabled though
```
# small sniff: show wireless interfaces (macOS/linux)
$ iwconfig || /sbin/iw dev
# or on mac: 
$ /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/Apple80211.framework/Resources/airport -I
```
emma: is the firmware recent? ISP boxes sometimes auto-update and break settings. if it's a managed modem-router, your provider portal might show recent events
ops-bot: Reminder: guest network certificates rotate weekly at 03:00 UTC. If experiencing auth issues, try reconnecting. (reaction: :repeat:)
chris: if you want a quick patch, try renaming the 5G SSID to something new and set it to an unused channel (36/40/44/48 are usually safe). also remove any weird DFS channels if the router exposes those
tanya: cat proofing tip: put a heavy coaster under the plant pot, or move it to the windowsill. cats + succulents = chaos :cat:
noah: renamed SSID -> rebooted host devices -> still nada. sniff shows no 5G beacon frames. logged into modem and scrolled through events: "phy0: radar event" a few minutes ago. so maybe DFS kicked it out
emma: radar detections will force the radio off for a while. some regions require you wait ~30 minutes. annoying but probably expected if you live near a weather radar or airport
noah: hmm that explains the timing (they were doing maintenance apparently). ok will wait it out. in the meantime i'm accepting sympathy gifs and cable management tips
chris: sympathy gif: :face_with_tear: and go buy velcro straps. also consider a small USB Wi-Fi dongle that supports 5GHz as a temporary client-side fix
tanya: or connect via Ethernet if you can route a cable temporarily. worst-case: tether to phone hotspot (data permitting)
ops-bot: Note: scheduled network maintenance in the building 2026-04-01 01:00-01:30 UTC may affect wired connectivity. (reaction: :wrench:)
noah: thanks, ops-bot — now i feel seen by infra gods. will post an "after" pic when the plant stops judging me
emma: also bonus tip — label both SSIDs with year, makes remembering firmware quirks easier (e.g., RedwoodGuest-2026)
chris: if you need music to cope, dropping my focus playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-link (reaction: :headphones:)
noah: update 45m later: 5GHz came back on its own, no idea which cosmic force reset it. moved the plant, cleaned the cables, and my cat is now a proud participant in cable art. pic: https://files.redwood.com/noah/desk_after_v2.jpg (reaction: :partyparrot:)
tanya: victory! cable art into cable museum pls :museum:
emma: award: Best Dramatic Return of a Wi-Fi Band 2026 :trophy:
noah: i'll accept trophies and coffee. thanks for the tips y'all :)
